caveats: Observed detention includes yard dwell, crew and locomotive changes and waiting for onward paths beyond this section, none of which section scheduling can fix. Rakes over 4x free-running are excluded, but even the filtered figure is an upper bound on what is recoverable.

Free-running times are a technical minimum, calibrated at 1.09 of measured on the median block. Detention is reported separately because it uses the same figure on both sides, so the modelling assumption cancels.
Demand is the arrivals the railway actually saw; upstream operations are not re-optimised.
Scheduled services are held fixed, so punctuality is unchanged by construction rather than by result.
